designationHistory.name: Desert Game Range
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Desert Game Range by Executive Order 7373; it is now Desert National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Desert National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7373—Establishing the Desert Game Range, Nevada (May 20, 1936)

review.note: EO 7373, 1936-05-20 (Franklin D. Roosevelt). Draft date field held "7373" (the EO number).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Roosevelt established the Desert Game Range for “the conservation and development of natural wildlife resources” ( Executive Order 7373 ).
